OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector e.g., the type of entities the connector imports.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: Time to wait between two runs of the connector, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `PT1H` for one hour)

TEMPLATE_API_KEY.description: API key used to authenticate against the external API.

TEMPLATE_IMPORT_SINCE.description: The start date (ISO 8601 format) for importing data. Can be either absolute e.g., a given date like '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z' or relative e.g., a given period of time like 'P30D' (meaning '30 days ago'). Used as the initial checkpoint on connector first run; subsequent runs resume from connector state.

TEMPLATE_TLP_LEVEL.description: Default TLP (Traffic Light Protocol) marking applied to every object this connector creates in OpenCTI.
